output.title: Aerobic Base Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min easy walking and mobility → Run 25 min steady continuous @ Zone 2 (HR under 142 bpm) → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Gentle aerobic run to initiate your training block with pure low-intensity running. Keep your pace strictly controlled and conversational throughout the entire duration. Reason: Establishing aerobic threshold efficiency without triggering systemic fatigue as you begin the 10-week progression. Benefit: Stimulates capillary proliferation and mitochondrial enzyme activity in slow-twitch muscle fibers. Warning: Keep your heart rate strictly below 142 bpm; if breathing becomes labored, slow down immediately.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Injury Resilience Bodyweight Strength
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min dynamic mobility and joint rotations → Bodyweight Squats: 3x10, 90s rest → Reverse Lunges: 3x8 each leg, 90s rest → Step-ups onto sturdy bench: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Standing Calf Raises: 3x15, 60s rest → Front Plank hold: 3x30s, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min gentle stretching. Overall: Foundational bodyweight strength session to build durable connective tissue and single-leg stability. Focus entirely on pristine biomechanics and full control rather than speed or fatigue. Reason: Early base development requires foundational structural strength to protect tendons and joints as weekly running volume increases. Benefit: Enhances hip stability, tendon stiffness, and joint resilience against repetitive running impact forces. Warning: Maintain deliberate, controlled posture on every repetition; stop a set early if your form breaks down.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Rest Day
output.description: Process: Rest day. Overall: Complete rest day dedicated to cellular recovery and structural adaptation. Keep movement low-stress and focus on quality sleep and hydration. Reason: Scheduled between initial workouts to allow muscle tissue to absorb the bodyweight strength loading. Benefit: Restores neuromuscular function and replenishes baseline glycogen stores. Warning: Resist the temptation to perform cross-training or heavy physical labor; prioritize rest.
output.fueling_tip: Focus on nutrient-dense meals with adequate protein (1.4-1.6g/kg) and steady baseline hydration.

output.title: Aerobic Foundation Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walking → Run 25 min continuous @ Zone 2 (HR 125-142 bpm) → Cool down 5 min easy walking. Overall: Second continuous aerobic run of the week on flat terrain to reinforce running economy. Keep your effort relaxed, relaxed, and fully conversational. Reason: Accumulating weekly low-intensity volume below your Aerobic Threshold (142 bpm) to foster basic aerobic efficiency. Benefit: Enhances lipid oxidation capacity and builds tissue tolerance in the lower legs. Warning: Avoid speeding up on open flat sections; monitor heart rate continuously to ensure you do not cross AeT.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Introductory Long Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min easy walking → Run 40 min steady aerobic @ Zone 2 (HR 125-142 bpm) → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Introductory long run of the block designed to comfortably build aerobic endurance. The duration is kept within strict proportionality limits to prevent excessive musculoskeletal stress. Reason: Gradually expanding time on feet to condition connective tissues and improve muscular fatigue resistance. Benefit: Increases stroke volume, expands vascular beds in working muscles, and strengthens aerobic fat burning. Warning: Do not race this workout or surge; keep the cadence light and stay well within your Zone 2 aerobic ceiling.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.
